title: Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors: set-up guides, editing, error detail and alerts for connector admins
summary: Hold for licensing corrections: Microsoft also permits federated connectors with Microsoft 365 E7, so the stated requirement to buy a Copilot add-on is too restrictive. The assurance that licensing is unchanged is not established by the sources. The roadmap facts and the principal management paths and commands are supported.

claims.claim: A permanent crawl failure marks the connection Failed and requires administrator intervention.
claims.quote: Some failures are temporary, and crawl resume automatically, while others are permanent and require administrative intervention to restart. If a permanent failure occurs, the connection is marked as **Failed**

claims.quote: If a permanent failure occurs, the connection is marked as **Failed**, and notifications are sent to the service health dashboard under the **Issues** section for your organization to act on.

claims.claim: Federated connectors require a Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on licence for every querying user.

claims.fix: Replace the federated-connector requirement in licensing.notes and Cost and licensing with 'Federated connectors require a Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on licence or Microsoft 365 E7 for every user who queries the federated source.' In rationale: cost, replace 'a Copilot add-on for federated connectors' with 'a Copilot add-on or Microsoft 365 E7 for federated connectors'. The qualification is in https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/connectors/prerequisites#licensing.

claims.claim: Connector licensing is unchanged by this release.
claims.quote: Searched: "502529" "licensing" "unchanged"; "Copilot connectors" "pre-setup" "license" "additional". Opened release-notes and connectors/prerequisites; they describe the release and current licensing but do not establish unchanged licensing across this release.
claims.fix: In rationale: cost, remove the assurance that licensing 'is unchanged'. After the existing statement that no feature-specific charge is published, use 'The prerequisites page describes connector licensing.' Keep the corrected current licence requirements, without asserting a historical comparison.

claims.claim: The editing route is Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Connectors > Your Connections > connection > Edit.
claims.quote:
To monitor errors, go to **Connectors** > **Your connections** in the Microsoft 365 admin center, select the connection, and choose **Error** in the connection details pane.
Select **Edit** to update the authentication credentials.

claims.claim: PATCH /v1.0/external/connections/{connectionsId} updates an external connection.
The documented Graph update properties are configuration, description and name, not the admin center's wider editable-settings list.
claims.quote:
The following properties can be updated.
configuration | microsoft.graph.externalConnectors.configuration
description | String | Description of the connection displayed in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
name | String | The display name of the connection

claims.claim: The Graph configuration property identifies additional application IDs allowed to manage the connection.
claims.quote: Specifies additional application IDs that are allowed to manage the connection and to index content in the connection.
